Visual Studio Code: Complete Developer Review & Analysis

Free / Open Source (MIT Base)

Overview & Target Audience

Visual Studio Code (by Microsoft) is targeted at Web, cloud, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and general multi-language developers.

Official Website: https://code.visualstudio.com/

The Good (Pros)

  • Massive extension marketplace with thousands of free themes, linters, and plugins
  • Lightweight core startup with high customization capability
  • Built-in Git integration, terminal, and remote debugging (SSH / Containers)
  • Completely free with gigantic community support

The Bad (Cons)

  • Electron-based app can consume significant RAM when loaded with heavy extensions
  • Out of the box experience requires installing extensions for specialized language support
  • Not a full zero-config IDE compared to JetBrains suites

Pricing & Licensing Model

100% Free for personal and commercial use.

Verdict: Who Should Use Visual Studio Code?

Every developer from beginners to seasoned pros who value versatility and an unmatched extension ecosystem.
